subject: reasoning
question:
A man walks 12 km north, then turns right and walks 8 km, then again turns right and walks 12 km.

How far is he from the starting point?
solution:
Given:

A man walks 12 km north, then turns right and walks 8 km, then again turns right and walks 12 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/912567ffcbf5a03d459edb5c24aa2a260272e2ec4748341b2ade25f0fad753ea.png] 

Thus, the man is 8 km far from the starting point.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
